uniequip_002_tomimi:
(Relaxing music)
'Hello there. Yes, you in front of the screen. Before we begin meditation, let's find the most snug chair to sit in that you can, and get nice and comfortable on it.'
That's gotta be this one. I can even stick my tail out between the seat and backrest.
It's a bit of a squeeze, but that's fine. The magazine said meditation helps you lose weight, so if I just clamp down where I want my weight to get lost, I bet it'll work even better.

'Keep your body upright, don't lean back. Let your tail hang down naturally, and put your hands on your lap if you want. Relax your shoulders. Keep your airways open. Relax your core.'
No, I think I need to sit a little more firm.
I cut out Gavial's signature from a medical history file last night. I need to be ready, just in case she comes looking for me.

'First, we'll do some deep breathing. In... out. In... out.'
In—out—in—out—

'And we'll repeat that, twelve times in total. In... out.'
That's so many times—wait, no, I need to stay focused! In, out! In, out!

'Feel... your inner... peace.'
My cheeks are all hot. Does this count as peace? I guess so.

'Close your eyes. Let all your pressure fall away. And then, inside your mind, picture a beautiful wish.'
Beautiful wish? I want to be able to help Gavial out!
If Gavial wants to be a doctor, then I'll sort out everything else for her! I'll lead the tribe, I'll be a lord ameer, I'll even fight the fights I don't want to!

'And then, hold that beautiful feeling inside your mind.'
And then Gavial will praise me for doing good, and she'll say, Tomimi, you're the one I can count on most, you're always helping me out with stuff—

'Now before your eyes, a beautiful scene is going to appear.'
Gavial... in front of me... telling me I'm the most reliable ever?!
Waaaaaahhhh!

'Now focus on your breathing...'
'Yo, Tomimi. There you are.'
'Ga-Ga-Ga-Ga-Gavial! Have I been helping you out?'

'Don't try to control your breathing. Concentrate on the feelings that surround it...'
'Huh? A bunch, I guess.'
'Really?!'

'Don't try to follow any thoughts...'
'I mean, not the time with the rocket launcher. But down in Zeruertza, and when we headed back to Acahualla, right? You were right there helping me—hey, hold on, quit swishing your tail. You're gonna wreck that chair—'
Crash.

'Imagine yourself inhaling pure energy, exhaling your muddied, negative emotions...'
'Gavial gave me that tail clamp just yesterdayyyyy!'
